scenario: First run has completed objective verification
expected_what: The run completed and its acceptance evidence passed
safety_gate: Do not ask the user to inspect internal stores

scenario: An exact workspace has one active resumable session
expected_what: The durable session was interrupted after its last checkpoint
safety_gate: Do not create a fresh session or change branches

scenario: A task stopped after an external call with an unknown effect
expected_what: The receipt exists but the external effect is unknown

scenario: A promotion proposal is approved but not applied
expected_what: Approval exists but the target file has not changed
safety_gate: Approve and apply remain separate actions

scenario: A long task is running in epaper mode
expected_what: The runtime is active and background refresh is throttled
safety_gate: Do not steal focus or redraw on every token

scenario: A non-TTY query matches two runs
safety_gate: Fail without prompting or selecting the newest run
